name: AI Product Engineer
target: Product-facing AI roles at startups shipping user-visible LLM features.

content.summary: Applied AI engineer who owns retrieval systems end to end — architecture, eval harness, LLM serving and cloud deployment. Shipped a multilingual RAG assistant now live in production on kheloindia.gov.in answering citizens in 12 languages, and sole-engineered a 60,000-LOC Parliamentary Question drafting platform piloted in a live 2026 Parliament session. Ships against measurement, not intuition: 213-case eval banks, judge-scored regression runs and latency budgets gate every release. National-level athlete and 7x hackathon placer.

blocks.title: Khelo India Knowledge Assistant — live in production on kheloindia.gov.in

bullets.text: Architected and shipped a citizen-facing multilingual RAG assistant on Azure — 206 documents / 11,611 chunks, 12 languages (9 voice-enabled) via Bhashini with Sarvam fallback, streaming SSE answers off a Service Bus queue and Redis pub/sub worker pipeline.

Designed hybrid retrieval that measurably beat naive cosine search: pgvector ANN over both content chunks and 86,000 generated hypothetical questions, fused with pg_trgm lexical search via Reciprocal Rank Fusion, per-document diversity caps and an optional Cohere cross-encoder — lifting judged correctness to 3.9 / 4 across a 213-case eval bank over 28 archived runs.

Built a LangGraph multi-agent router fanning vector retrieval and live CMS API orchestration out concurrently (~30 curated endpoints, no model-authored SQL) behind an env-flag kill switch; 532 offline tests across 40 modules; cut run-rate ~60% (₹9.4L → ₹3.5L/month) at ~₹1.35 per query, sized for 10,000 daily users.

blocks.title: PQ-Bot — Parliamentary Question drafting platform · MYAS / Sports Authority of India

bullets.text: Sole engineer on a ~60,000-LOC AI drafting platform (95 API endpoints, 34 tables, 33 migrations) piloted during the 2026 Parliament monsoon session, grounding official replies in a 702-document corpus of prior tabled Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha answers.

Built a 10-stage retrieval pipeline on AWS Bedrock — semantic cache, LLM query planner, verbatim answer-of-record reuse, pgvector search, LLM reranking, and recency blending with per-claim volatility half-lives — emitting per-sentence citations behind pre- and post-generation validation gates.

Added an LLM text-to-SQL layer over uploaded datasets hardened with sqlglot AST validation (SELECT-only, prefixed tables, statement timeouts, row caps) inside read-only transactions; two eval harnesses gate releases, 312 backend tests green, SAST closed at zero critical findings.

blocks.title: MYAS Task Tracker & Khelo India Expenditure Tracker — internal platforms, in production

bullets.text: Authored the system architecture, HLD/LLD and deployment design for both; re-platformed the task tracker from EC2/PM2 onto ECS Fargate (ARM64) + RDS Postgres 16 + ALB/WAF with GitHub OIDC CI/CD that runs migrations as an in-VPC one-off task and aborts the deploy on failure. Expenditure platform tracks ₹924 Cr of scheme budget across 14 regional centres.

experience.context: Oracle Cloud Partner — 20+ enterprise clients including Aditya Birla Group, Adani, and Acko.

bullets.text: Architected a Docker + GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline on AWS EC2 + Nginx, cutting deploy time 80% (15 min to under 3) with zero-downtime rolling releases.

Engineered a real-time inventory backend (Node.js, PostgreSQL, Redis) automating 3 reconciliation workflows and eliminating ~4 hrs/day of ops overhead; consolidated 15+ scattered permission checks into a single JWT RBAC middleware layer.
